resources.string: Same idea as realme UI 2/3 Super power saving. Black 6-app home, door to exit. Play services sleep. Wi‑Fi off while the screen is off. Incoming calls still work. Idle drain target: about 0–1% in 8 hours.
Tap to grant root in ResukiSU, then Allow
No root. Open ResukiSU → Superuser → allow Super Power Saving.
Tap an icon to change it. Phone / Messages / Browser are filled automatically.
The phone will restore the snapshot taken when you entered (CPU, Wi‑Fi, DT2W, Google, animations).
Turn on super power saving mode?

Takes a few seconds. A backup of every change is written first so Exit can restore it.

• Only these 6 apps on the black home
• Incoming calls / SMS (Jio VoLTE stays up)
• Google Play sleeps — WhatsApp push when you open it
• Wi‑Fi off while the screen is off
• Logs stay on (so you can report)
• Power button still wakes (DT2W off only while this mode is on)

Stuck? ResukiSU → Modules → remove this → reboot.
Tip: add the Super Power Save tile in Quick Settings.

Everything Super Power Saving is allowed to touch. Turn anything off and it will be left exactly as it is, then restored on exit like everything else.
